subject: Logic
title: 10-10-10 Rule
description: A fast breakdown of 10-10-10 Rule for builders.

hook.text: You're furious and about to send an angry email. Pause. How will you feel about this in 10 minutes? 10 months? 10 years?

buildup.text: The 10-10-10 rule forces you to evaluate a decision across three time horizons before acting.

discovery.text: Suzy Welch popularized this method to break the tyranny of present emotion over future wellbeing.

twist.text: Most regretted decisions optimize for the 10-minute feeling and ignore the 10-year consequence.

climax.text: The rule doesn't always change your answer—but it ensures you've considered all three time frames.

punchline.text: Zoom out before you zoom in.

quiz.question: What does the 10-10-10 rule help with?
options: Evaluating decisions across short, medium, and long time horizons
